# Amer Hamdan

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Tech Lead · AI-Product Development. Based in Istanbul, Türkiye. Open to senior full-stack, tech lead, and AI-product roles — remote or Istanbul.

Senior full-stack engineer and team lead with ten years building production web platforms across intelligence, news, recruitment, and commerce. Currently a lead contributor on a multi-product intelligence platform written in Go and TypeScript — a GraphQL/REST/WebSocket API over PostgreSQL, an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway with RAG and per-token billing, and a bilingual Next.js dashboard, all deployed to GKE and Cloud Run. Earlier work was mostly legacy migration: PHP to Laravel, WordPress to Next.js, with measurable gains in performance and engagement each time. Comfortable owning the whole path from schema to interface to infrastructure.
